segments.normalizedSource: ```swift class ViewWithBackgroundColorTooltip: UIView, UIToolTipInteractionDelegate { func toolTipInteraction(_ interaction: UIToolTipInteraction, configurationAt point: CGPoint) -> UIToolTipConfiguration? { let configuration: UIToolTipConfiguration? if let accessibilityName = backgroundColor?.accessibilityName { configuration = UIToolTipConfiguration(toolTip: "The color is \(accessibilityName).") } else { configuration = nil } return configuration } } ```
